fix_1_ad_status_extraction.description: Extracts ad active/inactive status strictly from authentic SourceRecord raw_data according to normalization contract (isActive, is_active, activeStatus, status). Preserves explicit False. Missing/ambiguous status is UNKNOWN (skips snapshot creation). Authentic timestamps only, no manufactured timestamps.

fix_2_apify_billing_double_counting.description: Authoritative usageTotalUsd used as total run cost without adding eventUsageTotalUsd. Realistic PPE payloads no longer double-count charges. Estimated billing marked not verified. Missing billing holds reservation cap.

fix_3_scheduler_collection_status.description: Corrected status mismatch: checks completed/partial instead of success. Associates genuine snapshots with specific completed collection runs and authentic SourceRecords. Zero records skips snapshot generation.
